title: Opening and Wolverines' awareness of their impact
summary: Perhannis introduces the session at Moore's Fort Lauderdale office and asks if the Wolverines knew they were at the forefront of jazz; Moore says no.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Opening the interview: introductions, date and place

blocks.x: All right, this is John Perhannis from Minneapolis, and I'm talking with Vic Moore at his office in Fort Lauderdale, Florida. And before the tape started, we were talking a little bit about Hoey Carmichael and her.

Would you say that when you first, when the Wolverines were formed, you were conscious of this band as being in the forefront of jazz musicians? No. That it was going to have such an impact that it later had? No.
